Proves AR-6's `inRange` operator on a `datetime` field with an exclusive `from` / inclusive `to` combination — the opposite combination from case 040, so both boundary/type variants are covered. Per SEM-4, both boundaries are already-resolved absolute instants (zone UTC) by the time the compiler sees them: no `AT TIME ZONE`/`$dateTrunc.timezone`/ES `time_zone` clause is ever emitted for a `datetimeValue` comparison. AG Grid's native `inRange` wire shape carries no inclusivity flags, so this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject a `rangeComparisonNode` with explicit `fromInclusive: false, toInclusive: true`; the sibling `requestContext.zone` field records the zone (UTC) the adapter used to resolve the two `datetimeValue` boundaries, per SEM-4's fixture-format note.
